|lore=Front: The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation is favorable not only for its captain and first mate, but for the Alliance as well.''<br />''Back: The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation is favorable not only for its captain and first mate, but for the Alliance as well. Enclosed.
|hatnote=Double-sided card (flips): the infobox and first image show the front (starship) side; the back (combat vehicle) side is shown second. Other versions of this Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card: [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT)]], [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata 2)]]. For the regular card, see [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (Errata 5)]].
|game_text='''Front side — [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]), Heavily-Modified Light Freighter'''

Destiny 0 · Power 3 · Deploy 0 · Forfeit 7 · Maneuver 4 · Hyperspeed 6<br />Icons: [[Nav Computer]] [[Resistance]] [[Scomp Link]] [[Episode VII]]

May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. While [Episode VII] Han or Rey piloting, maneuver +2 and immune to attrition &lt; 4 (&lt; 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if at a site, may flip this card (even if unpiloted).

'''Back side — [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle|Combat]]), Heavily-Modified Light Freighter'''

Destiny 7 · Power 3 · Deploy 0 · Forfeit 7 · Maneuver 5 · Landspeed 2<br />Icons: [[Resistance]] [[Scomp Link]] [[Episode VII]]

May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to Trample and Unsalvageable, even if unpiloted. While Finn or Rey aboard, immune to attrition &lt; 4 (&lt; 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if piloted, may flip this card.

|rulings=* If [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] is about to be lost, it is not possible to send it to a docking bay with [[I'll Take The Leader]]. [[The Falcon]] would go out of play first.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=The%20Falcon%2C%20Junkyard%20Garbage%20/%20%E2%80%A2The%20Falcon%2C%20Junkyard%20Garbage%20%28AI%29 Scomp: The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (AI)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* When [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] flips to the vehicle side, any starship weapons are lost (even [[Concussion Missiles]], which deploys on a freighter).
* When [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] flips to the vehicle side, any Devices or Effects (of any kind) which use a clause of their deployment text to deploy on and/or target the [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] as a starship, are lost unless that same deployment clause can also target vehicles. Do not recheck any other deployment conditions.
* Similar logic to the above two rulings applies when flipping [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] to the starship side (i.e. lose vehicle weapons, lose any Devices or Effects of any kind unless the deployment clause can also target a starship).
* Flipping from starship to vehicle causes attached Mynocks to detach.

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card (the AI images were renamed ALT by the PC; Bill, 12 Nov 2026). It is not the current version; the current version is [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The images are the Players Committee card images of both sides of this version ([[:File:V4-L-thefalconjunkyardgarbagefront_ai-2022-01-07.gif]], [[:File:V4-L-thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai-2022-12-12.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates of the card-size image (<code>large</code> folder) in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); pixel-identical re-uploads are not. '''What changed on the card''' (crops of the published images, pixels unchanged; lore box and bottom strip of the combat vehicle (back) side): [[File:V4-L-thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai-2022-12-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-L-thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai-2022-01-07.gif]], 7 January 2022) → [[File:V4-L-thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai-2022-12-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-L-thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai-2022-12-12.png]], 12 December 2022). '''Errata marks:''' this is errata 1 of the ALT card in release order; the back side prints “E2” and the front side prints no mark. Recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT)]]): PC card images of both sides uploaded 7 January 2022<ref name="img-204_35a-0" />. Document: starship (front) side: no errata mark, label “(AI)”, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”, art credit printed above the bottom margin (“Image courtesy of Paul Wiz Johnson@Artstation”); combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E”, label “(AI)”, bottom margin “Special Modifications”, lore “Han's “special modifications” for Millennium Falcon included security mechanisms, deflector shields, hull plating, faster hyperdrive and enhanced weapons. Enclosed.”.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image of the combat vehicle (back) side uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-204_35a-1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); its high-resolution copy (<code>hires/thefalconjunkyardgarbageback_ai.png</code>, same picture) was uploaded the day before, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 commit e9980f9] (11 December 2022). The card-size front image was not changed in that upload. The commit date is the upload date; the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/.</ref>; the front image was unchanged. '''What changed:''' the back side was re-made: its lore “Han's “special modifications” …” → the front side's lore (“The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation …”) followed by “Enclosed.”; bottom margin “Special Modifications” → “Legendary Starfighter”; errata mark “E” → “E2”; the Players Committee logo now prints left of “(AI)”; the art credit moved to the right edge (“Image courtesy of Paul “Wiz” Johnson @ ArtStation”) and the line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” was added; the game text is the same. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: starship (front) side: as in the original; combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E2”, label “(AI)”, Players Committee logo, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”, lore “The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation is favorable not only for its captain and first mate, but for the Alliance as well. Enclosed.”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image of the starship (front) side uploaded 19 February 2023<ref name="img-204_35a-2" />. '''What changed:''' the front side was re-made like the back: the art credit moved from above the bottom margin to the right edge (“Image courtesy of Paul “Wiz” Johnson @ ArtStation”), the line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” was added, the Players Committee logo now prints left of “(AI)”, the two icons beside the game text swapped places and the game text is wrapped differently; the words are the same. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: starship (front) side: no errata mark, label “(AI)”, Players Committee logo, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”; combat vehicle (back) side: as in PC-E1 (errata mark “E2”). It is the current printing of the ALT card.
